definitions.certification: Uses the exact required_queries/gated_classification functions from the hash-matched audit driver. All required replay obligations and provenance hashes are checked; no SMT solving is performed here.
definitions.conditional_rates: Strict/exact among each arm's verified successes. These denominators can differ; use paired metrics for an identical-program comparison.
definitions.partial_semantics: A conditional point rate is null while audits/replays of verified programs are pending. Confirmed lower bounds, classifications, and completion counts remain explicit.
definitions.cost: k=4/8/16 use actual accepted n=4 batch usage. k=1 estimates full first-batch input plus one quarter of its output. Reasoning is included in output, not added twice. Failed-attempt billing may be unavailable; no dollar charge is inferred. Prefix costs overlap.
definitions.time: Batch API duration includes retries where recorded; @1 has no separately measured one-choice latency.
definitions.no_new_experiment: This script reads existing records only. It does not invoke a model, verifier, semantic analysis, or training.
